column2: Refund or credit may be recommended if the request is made within 15 days of delivery and the goods are unused. The adjustments lead approves; finance posts.
After the return window, do not recommend a standard refund. Escalate for a commercial decision. The agent does not grant goodwill.
If two invoices cover the same order and delivery, draft a credit for the duplicate, for the lead and finance to approve.
If a prior refund is paid, do not draft a second refund. Explain the UTR and date.
Do not raise a second refund path. Cross-refer the dispute and route to billing / collections.
Escalate to finance the same hour. Do not also draft a voluntary refund that could double-pay.
Only a sales or care lead can propose goodwill. The agent never drafts it as approved.
The agent never processes a refund, posts a credit or tells the customer the money is on the way.
